note: Corps of Engineers campground on wooded ridges above Mark Twain Lake beside the Ray Behrens marina and boat ramp: three loops (Deer Run, Little Bluestem, Cedar Ridge) of paved back-in and pull-through sites, the full-hookup sites in Deer Run and Little Bluestem. The lake shows through the trees from the outer sites, clearest along Cedar Ridge's north side. --Claude
summary: Open for the tail of its season: Deer Run is selling through November 22, 2026; the other two loops are closed for the year. 165 electric sites (catalog; stored 157), 62 with water and sewer (stored note said 51), $24 electric / $30 full hookup (stored flat $24). Season written from the rate table and calendar. Lakeview stands on a filtered view. Pin is 350 m from the nearest site - move flagged. Phone found.
flags: SITE COUNT: stored 157 (note prose). recreation.gov's catalog has 165 overnight sites (Deer Run 53, Little Bluestem 69, Cedar Ridge 43) and one day-use shelter. Written 165.
FULL HOOKUPS: the stored note said 51 full-hookup sites; the catalog marks sewer and water on 62 (28 Deer Run, 34 Little Bluestem). The facility notices only say every site has 20/30/50A.

FEES: stored $24-24. The rate table has two STANDARD ELECTRIC templates, $24 and $30; the $30 one is the template on full-hookup site 030 (Deer Run), the $24 one on electric-only sites 017, 080, 102, 144, 148, 150. Written 24-30.

WHICH SITES SEE THE LAKE (stored lakeview - stands, on a filtered view): every loop is on a hardwood ridge with a band of timber on the slope between the sites and the water; nothing has an open apron. Per-site coordinates on leaf-off imagery: Cedar Ridge sites 144-150 on the main-lake (north) side are about 25-50 m from the shore, 139-143 about 50-90 m; Little Bluestem's outer sites (093-103) are 60-100 m from the coves; Deer Run's outer sites (011-019, 033-038) 60-110 m. recreation.gov's summer photo of site 150 shows open water through the tree trunks behind the pad, and site 102's shows it faintly; 148, 144 and 017 show only trees. No site carries a 'Proximity to Water' attribute. So: a through-the-trees view from perhaps a dozen sites, best at Cedar Ridge 146-150 - and Cedar Ridge is the loop with the shortest season (it opens in early May) and no water or sewer. Not lakefront.

PIN MOVE: stored 39.5158,-91.6631 is recreation.gov's facility point, in timber on a ridge with no road, about 350 m from the nearest site. Loop centres from the per-site coordinates: Little Bluestem (the largest, middle loop) 39.51803,-91.65877; Deer Run (the full-season loop) 39.51058,-91.66304; Cedar Ridge 39.52219,-91.65772. Suggested pin: Little Bluestem, 39.51803,-91.65877 (about 440 m east-north-east of the stored pin).

SEASON (none stored): written from the rate table and calendar - April 3 to November 22 in 2026, loops staggered as in the season note. The fall closing date of Little Bluestem and Cedar Ridge is not known exactly: the calendar shows both Closed from 2026-10-30, and past nights are no longer marked.
PHONE: none stored. recreation.gov gives 573-735-4097 for the campground (Mark Twain Lake project office line; marktwaininfo@usace.army.mil).
